faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Training & Placement Officer post.

faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 21 October 2026.

faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree (or equivalent) in Management, Human Resources, or a related field, along with a minimum of 10 years of relevant work experience.

faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications online through the designated Google Form link provided in the official notification.

faq.answer: It is a full-time contractual position at NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad.
